devdoc.details: ERC-4626 is a standard to optimize and unify the technical parameters      of yield-bearing vaults. This contract facilitates the minting and      burning of shares (stBTC), which are represented as standard ERC20      tokens, providing a seamless exchange with tBTC tokens.

AddressEmptyCode(address).details: There's no code at `target` (it is not a contract).

AddressInsufficientBalance(address).details: The ETH balance of the account is not enough to perform the operation.

ERC20InsufficientAllowance(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `spender`’s `allowance`. Used in transfers.

params.allowance: Amount of tokens a `spender` is allowed to operate with.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC20InsufficientBalance(address,uint256.details: Indicates an error related to the current `balance` of a `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.balance: Current balance for the interacting account.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC20InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSpender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `spender` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC4626ExceededMaxDeposit(address,uint25.details: Attempted to deposit more assets than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxMint(address,uint256,u.details: Attempted to mint more shares than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxRedeem(address,uint256.details: Attempted to redeem more shares than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxWithdraw(address,uint2.details: Attempted to withdraw more assets than the max amount for `receiver`.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExcessiveDebtRepayment(address,uint256,u.details: Used in the debt repayment function.

params.needed: Requested amount of assets repaying the debt.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

FailedInnerCall().details: A call to an address target failed. The target may have reverted.

InsufficientDebtAllowance(address,uint25.details: Used in the debt minting function.

params.allowance: Maximum debt allowance of the debtor.
params.needed: Requested amount of debt of the debtor.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC20 token failed.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

params.newAllowance: Maximum debt allowance of the debtor.

params.assets: Amount of assets for which debt will be taken.
Amount of assets repaying the debt.

params.depositOwner: Address of the owner of the deposit.
params.newShares: Amount of shares migrated to the new vault.

params.newDispatcher: Address of the new dispatcher contract.
params.oldDispatcher: Address of the old dispatcher contract.

params.entryFeeBasisPoints: New value of the fee basis points.

params.exitFeeBasisPoints: New value of the fee basis points.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

params.migrateTo: Address of the ERC-4626 contract to migrate to.

params.minimumDepositAmount: New value of the minimum deposit amount.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

params.newTreasury: Address of the new treasury wallet.
params.oldTreasury: Address of the old treasury wallet.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

approveAndCall(address,uint256,bytes).details: If the `value` is set to `type(uint256).max` then      `transferFrom` and `burnFrom` will not reduce an allowance.

params.spender: The address which will spend the funds.
params.value: The amount of tokens to be spent.

returns._0: True if both approval and `receiveApproval` calls succeeded.

assetsBalanceOf(address).details: This function is used to convert shares to assets position for         the given account. It does not take fees into account.

decimals().details: Decimals are computed by adding the decimal offset on top of the underlying asset's decimals. This "original" value is cached during construction of the vault contract. If this read operation fails (e.g., the asset has not been created yet), a default of 18 is used to represent the underlying asset's decimals. See {IERC20Metadata-decimals}.

deposit(uint256,address).details: Takes into account a deposit parameter, minimum deposit amount,      which determines the minimum amount for a single deposit operation.      The amount of the assets has to be pre-approved in the tBTC      contract.

params.assets: Approved amount of tBTC tokens to deposit. This includes               treasury fees for staking tBTC.
params.receiver: The address to which the shares will be minted.

returns._0: Minted shares adjusted for the fees taken by the treasury.

maxDeposit(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of the underlying asset that can be      deposited into the Vault for the receiver, through a deposit call.      If the Vault is paused, returns 0.

maxMint(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of the Vault shares that can be minted      for the receiver, through a mint call.      If the Vault is paused, returns 0.

maxRedeem(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of Vault shares that can be redeemed from      the owner balance in the Vault, through a redeem call.      If the Vault is paused, returns 0.

maxWithdraw(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of the underlying asset that can be      withdrawn from the owner balance in the Vault, through a withdraw call.      If the Vault is paused, returns 0.

migrateDeposit(address).details: This function is called by the contract owner to migrate the deposit      of the depositors without their approval.      The deposits that are being migrated have to be covered by the      assets deposited to the vault, which excludes the shares that were      minted as debt.Before the migration, ensure that the entry fee in the new vault      is set to 0, to avoid depositor being charged the entry fee.The implementation assumes the stBTC token won't be made fungible      before the migration and the migrated shares are limited to the      withdrawable shares.

params.depositOwner: The address of the owner of the deposit to migrate.

mint(uint256,address).details: Takes into account a deposit parameter, minimum deposit amount,      which determines the minimum amount for a single deposit operation.      The amount of the assets has to be pre-approved in the tBTC      contract.      The msg.sender is required to grant approval for the transfer of a      certain amount of tBTC, and in addition, approval for the associated      fee. Specifically, the total amount to be approved (amountToApprove)      should be equal to the sum of the deposited amount and the fee.      To determine the total assets amount necessary for approval      corresponding to a given share amount, use the `previewMint` function.

params.receiver: The address to which the shares will be minted.

mintDebt(uint256,address).details: The debt is calculated based on the current conversion      rate from the shares to assets.

params.shares: The amount of shares to mint.

returns.assets: The debt amount in asset taken for the shares minted.

mintReceipt(address,uint256).details: This function proxies `mintDebt` call and provides compatibility      with Mezo IReceiptToken interface.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: Requirements:      - The caller must be an authorized account to trigger pause.      - The contract must not be already paused.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

previewDeposit(uint256).details: Preview taking an entry fee on deposit. See {IERC4626-previewDeposit}.

previewMint(uint256).details: Preview adding an entry fee on mint. See {IERC4626-previewMint}.

previewRedeem(uint256).details: Preview taking an exit fee on redeem. See {IERC4626-previewRedeem}.

previewWithdraw(uint256).details: Preview adding an exit fee on withdraw. See {IERC4626-previewWithdraw}.

redeem(uint256,address,address).details: Redeem unallocated assets first and and if not enough, then pull      the assets from the dispatcher.

params.owner: The address of the owner of the shares.
params.receiver: The address to which the assets will be transferred.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

repayDebt(uint256).details: The debt to be repaid is calculated based on the current conversion      rate from the shares to assets.The debtor has to approve the transfer of the shares. To determine      the asset debt that is going to be repaid, the caller can use      the `previewRepayDebt` function.

params.shares: The amount of shares to return.

returns.assets: The amount of debt in asset paid off.

startMigration(address).details: This function is called by the owner to start the migration.      The migration can be started only once.

params._migrateTo: Address of the ERC-4626 contract to migrate to.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

totalAssets().details: The value contains virtual assets reflecting the debt minted by the      debtors. The debt is not backed by the deposited assets, and it is      used to adjust the total assets held by the vault, to allow shares      and assets conversion calculations.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

unpause().details: Requirements:      - The caller must be an authorized account to trigger unpause.      - The contract must be paused.

updateDebtAllowance(address,uint256).details: The current debt value is intentionally not checked to allow the      governance reduce the debt allowance in case the depositor      becomes risky or malicious.

params.newAllowance: Maximum debt allowance of the debtor.

params.newDispatcher: Address of the new dispatcher contract.

params.newEntryFeeBasisPoints: New value of the fee basis points.

params.newExitFeeBasisPoints: New value of the fee basis points.

params.newMinimumDepositAmount: New value of the minimum deposit amount. It        is the minimum amount for a single deposit operation.

updatePauseAdmin(address).details: Throws if called by any account other than the owner.

params.newPauseAdmin: New account that can trigger emergency        stop mechanism.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).details: Withdraw unallocated assets first and and if not enough, then pull      the assets from the dispatcher.

params.owner: The address of the owner of the shares.
params.receiver: The address to which the assets will be transferred.

totalDebt.details: This is the total amount of assets for which shares have been minted      without the coverage in deposited assets. The value is used to      adjust the total assets held by the vault.

ExceedsMaxFeeBasisPoints().notice: Reverts if the fee basis points exceed the maximum value.

LessThanMinDeposit(uint256,uint256).notice: Reverts if the amount is less than the minimum deposit amount.

SameDispatcher().notice: Reverts if the dispatcher address is the same.

SamePauseAdmin().notice: Reverts when the new pause admin address is the same as the         current pause admin address.

SameTreasury().notice: Reverts if the treasury address is the same.

ZeroAddress().notice: Reverts if a checked address is zero. Used by various contracts.

DebtAllowanceUpdated(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when the maximum debt allowance of the debtor is updated.

DepositMigrated(address,uint256,uint256,.notice: Emitted when a deposit is migrated.

EntryFeeBasisPointsUpdated(uint256).notice: Emitted when the entry fee basis points are updated.

MigrationStarted(address).notice: Emitted when the migration has started.

MinimumDepositAmountUpdated(uint256).notice: Emitted when deposit parameters are updated.

NonFungibleWithdrawalsDisabled().notice: Emitted when the non-fungible withdrawals are disabled.

PauseAdminUpdated(address,address).notice: Emitted when a pause admin address is updated.

TreasuryUpdated(address,address).notice: Emitted when the treasury wallet address is updated.

allowedDebt(address).notice: Returns the maximum amount of the underlying asset for which the      shares can be minted without the coverage in deposited assets.

approveAndCall(address,uint256,bytes).notice: Calls `receiveApproval` function on spender previously approving         the spender to withdraw from the caller multiple times, up to         the `value` amount. If this function is called again, it         overwrites the current allowance with `value`. Reverts if the         approval reverted or if `receiveApproval` call on the spender         reverted.

assetsBalanceOf(address).notice: Returns the number of assets that corresponds to the amount of         shares held by the specified account.

burnReceipt(uint256).notice: This function proxies `repayDebt` call and provides         compatibility with Mezo IReceiptToken interface.

currentDebt(address).notice: Returns the current debt of the debtor.

deposit(uint256,address).notice: Mints shares to receiver by depositing exactly amount of         tBTC tokens.

dispatcher().notice: Dispatcher contract that routes tBTC from stBTC to a given allocation contract and back.

migrateDeposit(address).notice: Migrates a depositor's funds to the new contract.

redeem(uint256,address,address).notice: Redeems shares for assets and transfers them to the receiver.

repayDebt(uint256).notice: Repay the asset debt, fully of partially with the provided shares.

startMigration(address).notice: Starts the migration to the new contract.

unpause().notice: Turns off the emergency stop mechanism.

updateDispatcher(address).notice: Updates the dispatcher contract and gives it an unlimited         allowance to transfer deposited tBTC.

updateEntryFeeBasisPoints(uint256).notice: Update the entry fee basis points.

updateExitFeeBasisPoints(uint256).notice: Update the exit fee basis points.

updatePauseAdmin(address).notice: Updates an authorized account that can trigger emergency stop         mechanism.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).notice: Withdraws assets from the vault and transfers them to the         receiver.

withdrawableShares(address).notice: The amount of shares that were minted for the receiver with the         deposit.

userdoc.notice: This contract implements the ERC-4626 tokenized vault standard. By         staking tBTC, users acquire a liquid staking token called stBTC,         commonly referred to as "shares".         Users have the flexibility to redeem stBTC, enabling them to         withdraw their deposited tBTC along with the accrued yield.
